concepts.headline: LET'S ADDRESS THE ELEPHANT IN THE ROOM

YOUR FEET GET ANOTHER SHIFT." (only the last sentence of that paragraph in bold) / "So we made it an easy choice:" followed by the blue bold underlined line "Black Friday, 60% off everything." / then the bold signature "- ComfortWear Team". Body text is large (about 3% of the image height per line) and the whole block is vertically balanced with even white space top and bottom.
